areas.label: Complete compiling dispatch draft
areas.evidence: All 48 top-level tag cases (0x81 through 0xB0) now have C draft handlers. make -j1 compare prints shiningsoul2_eu.gba: OK with the original ASM fallback; make -j1 nonmatching exits 0; check_tree reports 0 errors. This is a compiling checkpoint, not proof of equivalent C.

areas.label: Original 296-byte local frame
areas.evidence: Module disassembly now allocates exactly 0x128 bytes. Declaration order reproduces myId/ack/block/chunks/tag at SP+0x114/0x118/0x11C/0x120/0x124. The extra SP+0x128 slot came from retaining the player stride across sub_080020F4 in case 38. An empty register constraint on the earlier stride separates that pseudo value, so the later constant is rematerialized without an extra spill. No source ASM opcodes were added.

areas.label: Announce, chunk receipt and acknowledgement control flow
areas.evidence: Phases A-C now compile to the original instruction sequence and stack slots (myId/ack/blk/chunks/tag at SP+0x114..0x124, peer in r9) except two details: the 0x81 lower-bound compare is emitted as cmp #0x80/ble instead of cmp #0x81/blt, and the 0xB3 default is scheduled before instead of after the link-state AND. The restart loop is a label/goto (not for(;;)), and the phase-A flag, phase-C index and the case 0 / 0x13 loop counters are one variable.

areas.label: Payload effects and queue handling
areas.evidence: All 48 tag handlers reproduce the original code: typed player/entity/game-state views, block-local queue entries, an inline CpuSet helper for the 8-word record copy, the case 0x1B sub-switch in source order 5,6,8,7, and explicit base/offset/constant locals in case 0x21.
